title: Compare on the same scale
communicates: A difference in amount between alternatives.

source.title: Up and Down the Ladder of Abstraction
source.locator: Concrete examples, changing parameters, comparing outcomes

observation: The essay moves from individual runs to comparisons across parameter values.
interpretation: Aligned bars can isolate an outcome difference without changing the visual scale.
avoid: Independent scales that exaggerate a difference.
Implying measured time when the value is an operation count.
Changing an established symbol’s meaning to fit this pattern.
